findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 evidence command is `echo SCOPE_ACKED` instead of the literal intent CLI. The intent prescribes `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | grep -E "^[-+]" | grep -v lattice-baseline | ...| wc -l` expecting output 0, but that command currently returns 20 (non-zero) because 5+ additional entries beyond lattice-baseline were modified. The scope expansion is acknowledged in scope-contract.json, but the evidence must either (a) use a `waiver` kind with an explicit note citing the scope_contract_acknowledge, or (b) the intent command must be updated to exclude the acknowledged entries and verify the expansion is bounded. Using `echo SCOPE_ACKED` as the evidence command violates the evidence-must-bind-literal-intent-command rule — it does not execute the check, so the assertion is unverified.
